[EN] The {@LinkCreature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans}, along with their underlings, the {@LinkCreature:47#3002#argononomorph wendigos} and {@LinkCreature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos} are making trouble in {@Rgn:47004$$Blightroar}. Take their tokens to {@Creature:247#1005$$Chenace} and she'll reward you for your work.
[ES] Los {@LinkCreature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans}, junto con sus esbirros, los {@LinkCreature:47#3002#argononomorph wendigos} y {@LinkCreature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos} están causando problemas en {@Rgn:47004$$Blightroar}. Lleva sus fichas a {@Creature:247#1005$$Chenace} y te recompensará por tu trabajo.

[EN] Thanks for taking care of that, .
[ES] Gracias por encargarte de eso, .

[EN] Just take care of those {@LinkCreature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos}, {@LinkCreature:47#3002#argononomorph wendigos}, and the {@LinkCreature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans}, and I'll be happy.
[ES] Solo encárgate de esos {@LinkCreature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos}, {@LinkCreature:47#3002#argononomorph wendigos} y los {@LinkCreature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans}, y seré feliz.
